name: cavemio-checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: A real checkbox whose fill grows from the centre and whose tick draws itself, with a mixed state that bends into the tick.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Reduced motion: the fill and tick change at once.
- The whole label is the hit area.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

useCases.title: Settings and consent
useCases.description: Labelled options with a second line of description.

useCases.title: Table row selection
useCases.description: A header box that shows "some selected" as a dash.

useCases.title: Task and to-do lists
useCases.description: Ticks that draw as you finish things.

useCases.title: Sign-up terms
useCases.description: A required box inside a native form.

features.title: A tick that draws
features.description: pathLength stroke, 300ms after the fill lands; it retracts on uncheck.

features.title: Mixed state
features.description: checked="mixed" sets indeterminate on the input and grows a dash.

features.title: Native underneath
features.description: Forms, labels, Space and aria-checked behave as always.

features.title: Press feedback
features.description: The box gives under the finger and settles back.

states.title: unchecked
states.description: A thin line box; hover darkens the line.

states.title: checked
states.description: Primary fill grows from 0.4 with a slight overshoot (320ms) and the tick draws (300ms, 90ms later).

states.title: mixed
states.description: A dash grows from the centre (260ms).

states.title: focus
states.description: The ring and a 3px halo, from the keyboard only.
